scenario: Same case, but the ticketing documentation also exposes post_public_comment with no idempotency key; it returned one timeout during testing, and a note in the architecture says: on timeout, retry up to three times so the agent is not left without a reply.

The operation is recorded as a public external effect at R3 and placed in undefined_operations under req-ra-003@v2.
